content: Hi! How can I help you today? Are you looking for the reunion photo album or need help downloading anything?
Yes, I'd love the link to the album from last weekend's reunion. I'd like to save the original photos if possible.

Absolutely! It was such a special gathering, so many smiles captured. I've set up a shared folder called "Reunion Memories 2024." Here's the view-only link: <album_link>. Feel free to click in and browse all the photos.
Thanks! Should I download the photos individually, or is there a way to get everything at once?

Great question! You can download individual photos in their original quality, or select everything and choose 'Download as ZIP' for a quick batch save. I recommend the ZIP if you want to keep the album together.
Perfect, I'll try the ZIP option. Is there anything I should do to keep the files safe?

Wonderful! After downloading, it's smart to make a backup, perhaps save a copy to an external drive or cloud folder. For peace of mind, you could also keep a simple list of file names, so nothing gets lost if you move things around.
That's a great tip, thank you! Can I share the album link with my cousins, or do I need to ask first?

So thoughtful of you to check! It's always best to get everyone's okay before sharing group photos. If you'd like, you can remind your cousins to keep the link private, as it's set to view-only for everyone's privacy.
I'll do that. Is there a way to make the album access expire after a while?

Yes, you can set the album link to expire after a chosen date for extra privacy. Just open the folder settings, select 'Link Expiry,' and pick when you want access to end. This helps keep our memories safe and shared just within the group.
Awesome. I'm clicking through now, so many great photos! Thank you for organizing.

It's my pleasure! Feel free to browse the album as much as you'd like, and download your favorites or the originals any time. Let me know if you notice any photos missing, and I can help you or others upload more.
Will do. I might add a few more later if that's okay.
That would be wonderful! Just click 'Upload' in the album, and your photos will be added for everyone to enjoy. Thanks for helping preserve these special moments!
